sections.name: Spine
sections.say: Just hang and relax. Gravity gently decompresses your spine.

clips.shot: Full body front 3/4 view, dead hang from a black pull-up bar, arms straight overhead, body relaxed and long, feet off the floor; the whole spine and lats glow
clips.move: a calm dead hang, the body slowly lengthening and relaxing, tiny gentle sway

clips.shot: Rear view, dead hang from a black pull-up bar, arms straight, shoulders relaxed; the spinal muscles and lats glow intensely along the whole back
clips.move: a calm dead hang with slow deep breaths, the back lengthening
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right

cues: Here's the right way: a dead hang.
Just hang and relax. Gravity gently decompresses your spine.
